tests.name: Entra issuer/audience validation
tests.expected: Reject wrong audience, wrong issuer, expired token, ID token used as API token, and unauthorized calling client.

tests.name: Organization isolation
tests.expected: A user belonging to org A cannot select an org B connection or resource even when both users share the same Entra tid.

tests.name: Callback CSRF and replay
tests.expected: Wrong/missing state, reused code/transaction, expired transaction, changed Entra user/session and changed org all fail linking.

tests.name: PKCE
tests.expected: Wrong verifier and downgrade attempts fail; exact registered redirect URI is used.

tests.name: TPA client credentials
tests.expected: Verify only approved platform capabilities; pricing and orders never fall back to app credentials.

tests.name: TPA delegated scopes
tests.expected: Verify each granted scope, missing-scope denial, canceled consent, reconsent and account discovery.

tests.name: IB enrollment
tests.expected: Verify configured customer accounts only, allOrder.read/order.read behavior, and invoice scope names.

tests.name: OIDC federation candidate
tests.expected: ABC provisions compatible post/jwt auth, callbacks and identity scopes; Entra validates returned identity and sign-in succeeds.

tests.name: Cross-flow actor proof
tests.expected: If same-human binding is required, test approved ABC issuer+sub from federation against a separately verified API connection; email matching is rejected.

tests.name: Refresh lifecycle
tests.expected: Validate advertised expiry against token response; concurrency lock prevents double rotation; invalid_grant requires reconnect.

tests.name: Disconnect and logout
tests.expected: Local disable blocks immediate further calls; test provider revocation and independent Entra/ABC browser sessions.

tests.name: Membership and role changes
tests.expected: Removal or scope downgrade invalidates cached decisions while supplier tokens may still be valid.

tests.name: Branch/account authorization
tests.expected: Out-of-binding Ship-To, Bill-To, branch, order and invoice IDs are rejected before upstream execution.

tests.name: Mutation policy
tests.expected: A Viewer with a token containing ABC order.write still cannot submit; Purchaser still needs correct org/account and required approval.

tests.name: Webhook trust
tests.expected: Validate real secrets separately for update/invoice events; replay, unknown connection and cross-org payloads do not bypass authorization.

tests.name: Unattended behavior
tests.expected: Prove provider-approved user presence and background constraints before enabling delegated customer automation.

tests.name: Credential separation
tests.expected: No supplier tokens in browser/localStorage/agent arguments/claims/logs; no Entra tokens sent to ABC APIs.

tests.name: Secret/key rotation
tests.expected: Rotate platform signing keys via metadata/JWKS cache; rotate ABC client secret without exposing it or crossing environments.
